scripts.format: prettier --write package.json .prettierrc.json README.md "games/*/package.json" "games/*/README.md" site tooling docs .github/workflows
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json .prettierrc.json README.md "games/*/package.json" "games/*/README.md" site tooling docs .github/workflows
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test:games
scripts.build: npm run build:games && npm run build:site
